goal: The TUI transcript and the flywheel audit stream/CLI read the per-run JSONL file with live follow, terminal-status exit, and read-time redaction intact.

references: .flywheel/specs/00014-FEATURE-audit-redaction-layer.md -- the Redactor is wiring-agnostic; apply it to each parsed record at the new read path exactly as it applied to store records
constraints: Spec FR-8 is authoritative: cursor is a byte offset or line count; a missing file reads as empty; follow mode waits for the file to appear; a partial trailing line is withheld until complete or EOF-final
Terminal-status exit still comes from the lifecycle row (load_lifecycle), not the file
Redaction remains read-time and on by default in the CLI with --raw opt-out, unchanged from 00014
Update the audit-stream section of docs/vision.md to describe the file-backed stream and the ledger/telemetry split
Sweep every test that drives audit.stream or the TranscriptTailer through read_audit_since and retarget them to the file path in the same commit
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: Do not remove read_audit_since or any store verb -- schema-reduction owns the deletions
edge_cases: Operator deletes the run file mid-tail: surface end-of-stream gracefully, never crash the TUI
TUI opened mid-run starts from the beginning of the file and catches up
